test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Abir sells an article to Kunal at the profit of 15% and Kunal sells it to Amar at the profit of 10%. If Amar pays Rs. 5,060 for it, what was its original cost price?
solution:
**Given:**

Abir sells an article to Kunal at the profit of 15% 

Kunal sells it to Amar at the profit of 10%

Amar pays Rs. 5,060

**Concept used:**

SP = CP(1 + P%)

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

CP of Amar = SP of Kunal

Then,

SP of Kunal = CP(1 + 10%)

⇒ 5060 = CP(1 + 0.10)

⇒ 5060 = CP × 1.10

⇒ CP = 5060/1.1 = Rs. 4600

CP of Kunal = SP of Abir, Then

⇒ SP of Abir = CP(1 + 15%)

⇒ 4600 = CP(1 + 0.15)

⇒ 4600 = CP × 1.15

⇒ CP = 4600/1.15 = Rs. 4000

**∴ The original cost price was Rs. 4000.**
